scheme_name: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for Patent Registration
other_conditions: Must be a micro, small, or medium enterprise (MSME) in the powerloom sector.
Must have started production between 01-01-2022 and 31-12-2024.
Must have executed a four‑party agreement with the Directorate of Textiles, a financial institution, and Tantuja.
Must be a private sector, cooperative sector, joint‑sector undertaking, or a company/undertaking owned and managed by the State Government or industrial SHGs.
Project must be covered by a detailed feasibility report and be approved and sanctioned by a central financial institution, commercial bank, or state financial institution.
benefits_summary: 50% subsidy up to a maximum of ₹5,00,000.
